title: Bangladesh to open new visa centres in Kolkata and Siliguri on 1 December under new operator
dek: Swift Global Gateway Services replaces DU Digital Global; the Kolkata centre moves to Salt Lake Sector V and Siliguri’s to Sevok Road.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Bangladesh will open new visa application centres in Kolkata and Siliguri on 1 December under a new private operator, its Deputy High Commission in Kolkata said in a notice on Tuesday, a week after it said the existing centres would close at the end of November.

The new centres will be run by Swift Global Gateway Services (SGGS), which the Bangladesh government has contracted to replace DU Digital Global, whose outsourcing agreement expires on 30 November and was not renewed, according to reports. The Kolkata centre will be at Simsis Tower, Plot Y-13, Block EP and GP, Salt Lake Sector V, and the Siliguri centre on the first floor of City Mall on Sevok Road.

The centres will take applications from Indian citizens living in West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and Chhattisgarh, and from foreign nationals with long-term residence in those states, the notice said, according to reports. The mission had earlier advised applicants not to submit applications at the old centres after 30 November, and said the change did not mean a suspension of visa issuance.

The centres handle applications from Indians travelling to Bangladesh for family visits, business, tourism and study, a route used heavily by families on both sides of the Bengal border. Travel between the two countries has fallen sharply since August 2024, when India curtailed visa services for Bangladeshis after the fall of Sheikh Hasina's government, and relations have been strained further by her continued stay in Delhi.
